title: Undersea tunneling on 21km Thane Creek stretch advances as NHSRCL deploys custom TBMs
explanation: Complex geological strata under Thane Creek requires slower TBM advance rates, critical path for Mumbai terminal commissioning.

title: Subansiri Lower Hydro Unit 4 achieves commercial operation; remaining 4 units on track for 2026 completion
explanation: NHPC successfully synchronizes 1,000 MW capacity with national grid; dam structure reinforces flood moderation in Brahmaputra basin.

title: NHAI accelerates Package 17 works to complete JNPT port spur on Delhi-Mumbai Expressway
explanation: Final southern connectivity stretch targeting completion to divert heavy cargo traffic away from congested Mumbai suburban roads.

title: Full 1,506-km Western Dedicated Freight Corridor commissioned following Sanand-JNPT stretch opening
explanation: Direct double-stack container train transit between northern industrial hubs and JNPT reduces transit times by over 50%.

title: Godavari seasonal discharge prompts technical safety audit of Polavaram spillway and diaphragm wall
explanation: High velocity flood water scouring requires reinforced vibro-stone columns before Phase-1 impoundment to +41.15m level.

title: CCEA approves enhanced equity support of ₹8,962 Cr for HPCL Rajasthan Refinery (HRRL) ahead of SCOD
explanation: Cabinet approval clears financial closure for final utility packages and ethylene cracker integration at Pachpadra complex.

title: RVNL achieves 40th tunnel breakthrough across Main Central Thrust on Rishikesh-Karnaprayag alignment
explanation: Over 205 km of total tunneling completed; seismic sensors and drainage adits installed to counter subterranean aquifer pressures.

title: BMRCL conducts dynamic train trials on Yellow Line; civil works on Airport Blue Line cross 60%
explanation: Arrival of indigenous trainsets from Titagarh-CRRC joint venture enables driverless CBTC system validation.

title: Zojila Tunnel main tube breaks through eastern portal at Minamarg, cutting winter isolation for Ladakh
explanation: Historic excavation milestone reached despite extreme high-altitude alpine conditions (-25°C), commissioning slated for 2028.
